newsitem.title: USA: Former FBI official joins Charles Schwab.
newsitem.headline: Former FBI official joins Charles Schwab.

text.p: ORLANDO, Fla., Nov 6, Reuter - Charles Schwab & Co Inc said Wednesday that it hired Jim Freeman, former special agent in charge of the Federal Bureau of Investigation's office in San Francisco, to oversee information security.
Freeman, who was involved in the Unabomber and Polly Klass cases while heading up the FBI office, was given the title of vice president-director of risk management.

David Pottruck, Schwab president, said at Schwab's annual institutional conference in Orlando, that one of Freeman's responsibilities will be to insure security on the Internet, especially in its eSchwab computer trading.
"He'll go after anyone trying to break our Internet security," Pottruck said.
